uncertainty.assumption: independent sampled tasks; repeats do not increase task count
uncertainty.bounded_mean_method: Hoeffding, clipped to [0,1] for success and [-1,1] for differences
uncertainty.interval_scope: pointwise 95%; not simultaneous across conditions, metrics or time
uncertainty.resampling_unit: task, retaining all attempts and paired replicate seeds
uncertainty.standard_error_method: sample standard deviation of task means / sqrt(tasks)
